title: Hard-coded 2-second splash delay
description: The splash screen waits a fixed 2 seconds before routing.
repro: Launch app; observe 2s delay regardless of auth/onboarding state.
impact: Slower perceived performance; unnecessary wait on every launch.
fix: Route immediately after hydration/auth check; show splash only during async initialization.

title: No skip option for returning/reinstalling users
description: Users who reinstall must click through all onboarding slides.
repro: Open onboarding; look for skip/close control.
impact: Friction for power users; potential churn.
fix: Add 'تخطي' link when user is already authenticated or has completed onboarding before.

title: No rate limiting or account lockout
description: Login endpoint allows unlimited password attempts.
repro: Send repeated incorrect password requests; observe no throttling.
impact: Account takeover via brute force/credential stuffing.
fix: Implement progressive delays max-attempt lockout optional CAPTCHA and IP-based rate limiting.

title: Missing forgot password and password visibility
description: Login form lacks password visibility toggle and forgot-password flow.
repro: Open login; observe password field and surrounding links.
impact: Users cannot recover accounts or verify password input.
fix: Add visibility toggle and 'نسيت كلمة المرور' flow via email/SMS OTP.

title: DXN membership number not verified
description: Registration accepts any DXN ID without validation.
repro: Enter fake DXN ID during registration; observe acceptance.
impact: Fake accounts invalid distributor records data quality issues.
fix: Integrate DXN member lookup API; reject invalid IDs; encrypt stored IDs.

title: No ToS/privacy consent checkbox
description: Registration does not capture explicit user consent.
repro: Open registration; look for consent checkbox or policy links.
impact: GDPR/compliance risk; invalid consent records.
fix: Add required consent checkbox and links to terms/privacy.

title: Progress stored client-side only
description: User progress and unlock state live in local memory.
repro: Complete a level reinstall app observe progress lost.
impact: Data loss across devices; leaders cannot track real progress.
fix: Persist progress/XP to backend; sync on app open and after each level.

title: Daily progress bar hard-coded
description: Daily progress value is fixed at 55%.
repro: Open home; progress bar always shows ~55%.
impact: Misleading user feedback; broken gamification loop.
fix: Compute from completed lessons / daily goal in real time.

title: Locked nodes still appear interactive
description: Locked skill nodes are not clearly disabled.
repro: Tab through skill tree; locked items receive focus and look tappable.
impact: Confusion; accessibility violation.
fix: Set aria-disabled opacity and remove pointer cursor; use lock SVG.

title: XP/score computed client-side without server validation
description: Quiz completion awards XP based on client state.
repro: Modify client state to mark all answers correct; observe XP granted.
impact: Users can spoof progress and unlock levels without learning.
fix: Submit answers to backend; return validated score XP and unlock events.

title: Hearts system not persisted or regenerated
description: Hearts reset on every session and have no refill timer.
repro: Miss a question close app reopen; hearts restored to 3.
impact: Game economy broken; unfair advantage or user lockout.
fix: Persist hearts server-side; implement refill timer and gem conversion.

title: Single-round implementation instead of SRS 3-round flow
description: Chat Battle currently ends after one round.
repro: Start chat battle; only one prompt/response pair occurs.
impact: Does not meet requirement; poor training fidelity.
fix: Implement multi-round engine with branching and trust accumulation.

title: Trust bar updates instantly without animation or threshold warnings
description: Trust bar jumps values; no visual transition.
repro: Answer in chat; trust changes abruptly.
impact: Users may not perceive negative impact; less engaging.
fix: Animate bar changes; show red/yellow/green zones and labels.

title: UI does not implement two-column matching interaction
description: Match Pairs renders options as a single list.
repro: Open match screen; no pairing interaction visible.
impact: Exercise type does not match SRS; poor UX.
fix: Implement two-column layout with item selection or drag-and-drop.

title: No drag-to-reorder interaction
description: Order Sequence shows static numbered cards.
repro: Open order screen; try to reorder items.
impact: Core mechanic missing; exercise unusable.
fix: Add drag-and-drop with keyboard alternative.

title: Share achievement button is non-functional
description: 'مشاركة الإنجاز' does nothing when clicked.
repro: Complete level; tap share button.
impact: Social viral loop broken; reduced engagement.
fix: Implement Web Share API fallback + generated achievement image.

title: Next level always routes to main dashboard
description: After completion 'Next Level' returns to home.
repro: Complete a level; click next level; observe home screen.
impact: Interrupts flow; extra taps reduce engagement.
fix: Compute and route to the next unlocked level directly.

title: Menu items are non-actionable stubs
description: Profile menu items do not navigate or perform actions.
repro: Tap any menu item on profile.
impact: Core self-service features missing.
fix: Implement each destination or disable with tooltip until ready.

title: Mixed Arabic/English labels in stats cards
description: Stats labels use English 'Streak' and 'XP' alongside Arabic.
repro: Open profile; view stats row.
impact: Inconsistent localization; unprofessional appearance.
fix: Use full i18n keys and consistent Arabic copy.

title: Send encouragement button is non-functional
description: Leader cannot send encouragement notifications.
repro: Open team screen; tap 'إرسال تشجيع'.
impact: Core leader feature missing; team engagement tool broken.
fix: Implement push/in-app notification for selected members.

title: Admin panel missing Content Users Teams Analytics Settings modules
description: Only admin overview exists; SRS mandates full CMS.
repro: Open admin area; compare to SRS section 6.7.
impact: Admins cannot manage content or users; blocks production readiness.
fix: Build remaining modules: Content CRUD Scenario Builder Users Teams Analytics Settings.

title: Admin route lacks RBAC enforcement
description: No client or server check prevents trainees accessing admin.
repro: Log in as trainee; navigate to /admin/overview directly.
impact: Privilege escalation; unauthorized admin access.
fix: Gate route on authenticated role; validate role server-side for every admin API.

title: Emoji used as iconography throughout app
description: Hearts stars checkmarks and lock use emoji.
repro: Inspect home quiz profile; note emoji icons.
impact: Inconsistent rendering screen-reader noise brand risk.
fix: Replace with SVG icon set; add aria-label/aria-hidden.

title: No comprehensive error states defined
description: Missing offline timeout 401/403 empty state UI.
repro: Disable network; access screens.
impact: Users see blank screens or generic crashes.
fix: Design and implement error/empty/offline states per screen.

title: No analytics error reporting or performance monitoring
description: Product and technical observability tools not integrated.
repro: Search codebase for Sentry/PostHog/Web Vitals.
impact: Blind to user behavior crashes and performance regressions.
fix: Integrate Sentry + PostHog + Web Vitals; add custom events.
